messages:
ana: FYI auditor requested evidence tying recent RBAC updates to KMS usage and showing no key exports. They asked for: list of changed roles, approvers, CloudTrail snippets for KMS ops, and a short control-mapping doc. looping @auditor_jess :wave:

mike: pulling PRs and approval threads now. will export CloudTrail for the key alias used by inference-prod.

liz: which alias did we use for inference-prod? we rotated a wrapping key early March IIRC.

james: alias/ri-inference-prod-wrap. rotation run finished 2025-03-10T03:12Z. I can attach rotation manifest and key policy diff.

ana: tiny correction — @mike please include the JIRA IDs and the approval list (names + timestamps). auditor wants explicit approver evidence.

mike: got it. JIRA-SEC-3421 (svc-account role change), JIRA-OPS-4012 (k8s rolebinding pruning). approvals: liz@2025-03-09T14:12Z, james@2025-03-09T14:15Z, ana@2025-03-09T15:21Z. uploading links.

auditor_jess: thanks. For key export proof we need CloudTrail records for GenerateDataKey, GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext, Encrypt, Decrypt on the key ARN, plus the key policy snapshot and rotation manifest if available. Also a one-paragraph mapping each artifact to the control objective.

liz: splunk query I used to get CloudTrail KMS ops:
```
index=cloudtrail eventName IN (GenerateDataKey, GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext, Encrypt, Decrypt) resource=arn:aws:kms:*:111122223333:key/1234abcd
| table _time, eventName, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters
| sort _time desc
```

mike: export complete. uploaded s3://redwood-audit-buckets/soc2/2025-03/kms-cloudtrail-inference-prod.csv :thumbsup:

james: rotation manifest, checksum, and key policy diff attached to JIRA-SEC-3421. manifest contains rotation-actor signature.

ana: auditor also wants proof RBAC changes didn't add external principals or break-glass. provide rolebinding snapshots before/after + reconciliation job output.

oncall: ran snapshot job for staging and prod. summary:
```
- staging: 12 bindings changed, no external principals added
- prod: 4 bindings changed, one service-account modified (svc/ingest-processor)
```

oncall: full JSON snapshots uploaded to s3://redwood-audit-buckets/soc2/2025-03/rbac-snapshots/{staging.json,prod.json}

auditor_jess: good. Also need the vuln triage note for JIRA-SEC-3421 to ensure the change wasn't a risky remediation.

mike: triage note: replaced cluster-admin binding on deprecated svc with least-priv svc-role. no new privileges added. no CVE linkage. added RBAC lint unit tests. attached to JIRA-SEC-3421.

liz: we'll also pull activity logs for svc/ingest-processor during rotation window 2025-03-10T00:00Z..2025-03-11T00:00Z.

mike: pulled auth-telemetry and redacted PII, uploaded s3://redwood-audit-buckets/soc2/2025-03/svc-ingest-activity-20250310.csv

nana: drafting the mapping doc. current mapping draft:
- Control: Change management (SOC2 CC6) => JIRA tickets, PRs, approval timestamps
- Control: Key management (ISO 5.1 / SOC2 CC3) => KMS rotation manifest, CloudTrail export, key policy diff
- Control: Access logging & monitoring => auth-telemetry, rolebinding snapshots, reconciliation results
- Control: Vulnerability management => triage notes, tests added
Please flag any gaps and assign owners.

mike: gap: need signed snapshot of rolebinding diff (timestamp + sha256). I'll generate and sign with infra-release key and upload.

james: I'll produce a policy attestation PDF and timestamp it in the evidence bundle.

auditor_jess: excellent. When you upload please ensure objects are private, SSE-KMS enabled, and include the ticket link in metadata. Also a 1-page narrative that links each artifact to the control will let us close the evidence request. redact user emails in public artifacts but keep ARNs/principalIds for chain-of-custody.

ops-bot: Evidence upload checklist reminder:
- ACL=private
- lifecycle tag: soc2-evidence/2025-Q1
- server-side encryption: SSE-KMS
- add JIRA ticket link to object metadata

liz: confirmed uploads have SSE-KMS and private ACL.

oncall: question: do we want to redact email addresses from CloudTrail extracts? auditor_jess any preference?

auditor_jess: redact native emails for distribution, but include user ARN or principalId in artifacts. that's sufficient.

nana: thanks team. I'll finalize the one-pager and assemble evidence-bundle v1 and upload to s3://redwood-audit-buckets/soc2/2025-03/evidence-bundle-v1.zip then update the auditor ticket. ping me if anything else is needed. :rocket:
